tools.name: threat-hunting-with-sigma-rules
tools.desc: Use Sigma detection rules to hunt for threats and analyze security events.

tools.name: ASD-AuDHD-PAI-Skills
tools.desc: New collection, first skill pda-reframing can reframe requests or decisions to defeat Persistent Demand Avoidance flavors of autism spectrum disorders, or people with ADHD that struggle to Start tasks

tools.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
tools.desc: Coding habits inspired by Andrej Karpathy's public advice, written up by the community (not by Karpathy): think before coding, keep changes small and simple, check your work.

vetted.cmd: claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills.git --scope project && claude plugin install andrej-karpathy-skills@karpathy-skills --scope project
vetted.note: Plain-English coding habits for Claude (think first, keep changes small and simple); nothing runs on your computer. No licence file, so we link to it rather than copy it.

tools.name: octo
tools.desc: Second opinions: runs other AI models against the same design, research or code.

vetted.cmd: claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/nyldn/claude-octopus.git --scope project && claude plugin install octo@nyldn-plugins --scope project
vetted.note: Not for beginners: runs several paid AIs at once, some with their safety prompts switched off, and its council features can send your project files, including secrets, to companies other than Anthropic.

tools.name: perplexity
tools.desc: Web research with sources, from Perplexity's API.

vetted.cmd: claude mcp add perplexity --scope project --env PERPLEXITY_API_KEY=your-key -- npx -y @perplexity-ai/mcp-server@1.3.0
vetted.note: Whatever Claude asks, which can include your project details, goes to Perplexity and is billed to your key. Pin the version and set a spend cap.

tools.name: claude-mem
tools.desc: Memory across sessions: Claude remembers what happened last time.

vetted.cmd: claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem.git --scope project && claude plugin install claude-mem@thedotmack --scope project
vetted.note: Not for beginners: records everything Claude sees, including any passwords in files it opens (redaction is off by default), keeps it on your computer and sends it to Claude to summarise. Telemetry is on by default.

tools.name: headroom
tools.desc: Compresses what is sent to the model so long sessions cost fewer tokens.

vetted.cmd: claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official.git --scope project && claude plugin install headroom@claude-plugins-official --scope project

tools.name: ui-ux-pro-max
tools.desc: A design brain for screens: styles, palettes, fonts and UX rules. Its search needs Python 3.

vetted.cmd: claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill.git --scope project && claude plugin install ui-ux-pro-max@ui-ux-pro-max-skill --scope project
vetted.note: Adds seven design helpers (about 700 tokens per session) that only run when you ask for design work. The main one works fully offline; its logo and icon tools send prompts to paid AI services only if you give them an API key. Its search needs Python 3.

tools.name: glif
tools.desc: Generates images, video and audio from Claude.

vetted.cmd: claude mcp add --transport http glif https://glif.app/api/mcp --scope project
vetted.note: Your prompts, plus any files Claude uploads, go to Glif's closed servers, and generating media spends credits.

tools.name: awesome-design-md
tools.desc: Style notes from real brands: not a skill, a library of `DESIGN.md` files. Copy the one you like into your project.

vetted.cmd: claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official.git --scope project && claude plugin install awesome-design-md@claude-plugins-official --scope project
vetted.note: Style notes from real brands to drop into your project. If Claude ever offers to run a command it found in one, say no.

tools.name: tvc-director
tools.desc: An ad creative director: turns a product brief into Nano Banana Pro keyframe prompts and Seedance video scripts that you paste into those tools. Written mostly in Chinese.

vetted.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d) && git -C "$d" init -q && git -C "$d" fetch -q --depth 1 https://github.com/Ethanxwang/tvc-director.git 593149aba220361bd2c3e9059516c890081ada00 && git -C "$d" checkout -q FETCH_HEAD && rm -rf "$d/.git" && mkdir -p .claude/skills && cp -R "$d" .claude/skills/tvc-director && rm -rf "$d"

tools.name: core-web-vitals
tools.desc: Finds what makes pages slow to load and jumpy. Some of its links point to sister files that aren't copied in; it works without them.

vetted.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d) && git -C "$d" init -q && git -C "$d" fetch -q --depth 1 https://github.com/addyosmani/web-quality-skills.git afa8da942115f2961fdbfa80807ea0b232ff6c00 && git -C "$d" checkout -q FETCH_HEAD && mkdir -p .claude/skills && cp -R "$d/skills/core-web-vitals" .claude/skills/core-web-vitals && rm -rf "$d"
